evidence.quote: - Unlimited number of pages when designing your custom website

signals.finding: 1 review (0.9% of all) say support is slow or gone.

signals.label: Tier trap
signals.finding: The $49 tier lacks 7 of 8 features in the $98 tier.

evidence.quote: Plan 1 - Basic 1 ($49): Limited customization, logo, thumbnails, images & colors; 1 admin account; 10% sales commission rate

signals.label: Vendor age & track record

signals.label: Discount size

signals.label: One-sided change clauses
signals.finding: The terms let the vendor change features or pricing at any time.

claims.text: Codes must be redeemed within 60 days of purchase

quote.text: You must redeem your code(s) within 60 days of purchase

claims.text: Forento allows selling courses, downloadables, sessions, events and videos

quote.text: Forento allows you to sell various information-based products, including courses, downloadables (e.g., e-books, worksheets), sessions (one-on-one coaching), events (online or in-person), and videos.

claims.text: Website setup uses builder, template selection and subdomain choice

quote.text: To set up your Forento website, enable the website builder, select a template, and choose a subdomain.

claims.text: Products can be showcased via Course Element or manual elements linking to products

quote.text: You can showcase your products using the Course Element, which automatically displays all published courses, or manually by adding elements like images, text, and buttons that link directly to your products.

claims.text: Email Automation sends automated emails triggered by user actions

quote.text: Forento's Email Automation feature allows you to send automated emails triggered by user actions, such as welcome emails upon sign-up or introduction emails when a user accesses a course.

claims.text: Log-in and sign-up pages can be customized with logo and brand color

quote.text: Yes, you can customize the log-in and sign-up pages by adding your logo, thumbnail, and changing the brand color.

claims.text: Community feature lets members connect, share insights and ask questions

quote.text: Forento's community feature allows members to connect, share insights, and ask questions.

finePrint.summary: Lifetime-deal buyers can create unlimited products, but video hosting remains subject to limits.

quote.text: Forento allows Customers to create an unlimited number of products (including, but not limited to, courses, digital downloads, and memberships).

finePrint.summary: Paid subscribers get reasonable video storage and bandwidth included in their subscription fee.

quote.text: For Customers on an active paid Subscription (monthly or yearly), reasonable video storage and bandwidth is included as part of the applicable Subscription fee.

finePrint.summary: Team size is capped by admin seats, with only Scale offering unlimited admins.

quote.text: Admin accounts are seats for team members or co-administrators. Multiple seats let your team manage an academy without sharing login details.

finePrint.summary: After the 30-day trial, buyers can cancel anytime but generally get no refund.

quote.text: You will not be charged if you cancel during the 30-day trial. After the trial you can cancel at any time, but refunds are generally not offered.

finePrint.summary: Cancelling a subscription early does not give a partial refund or credit.

quote.text: Forento does not provide refunds or credits for any partial Subscription periods.

finePrint.summary: Lifetime-deal purchases are refunded under the marketplace's policy, not Forento's.

quote.text: Purchases made through such marketplaces are governed by the relevant marketplace's own terms and refund policy, and all payments are handled solely by the relevant marketplace.

finePrint.summary: Forento can update its terms at its own discretion, which could affect lifetime-deal buyers.

quote.text: Forento retains the right to update, amend or otherwise modify these Terms of Use at its own discretion.

finePrint.summary: Forento can modify, suspend or remove services without prior notice.

quote.text: Forento reserves the right to modify, suspend, remove, and amend the Services, including the content of the Services, in its own discretion and without prior notice.

finePrint.summary: Offer terms can be changed anytime without notice, except for already confirmed purchases.

quote.text: Forento maintain the right to change the terms of an Offer at any time (however not in relation to purchases already confirmed), without prior notice to the Customer.

finePrint.summary: Non-payment can lead to suspension or termination until payment succeeds.

quote.text: In the event of non-payment or failed charge, Forento retains the right to suspend or terminate the Customer's access to the Services until payment has been successfully received.

finePrint.summary: If suspended or terminated for breach, buyers get no reimbursement of prior payments.

quote.text: In the event that Forento suspends or terminates Customer's use of the Service or these Terms of Use, Customer understands and agrees that Customer shall not be entitled to any reimbursement of payments previously made to Forento.

finePrint.summary: Excessive video storage without sales can lead to suspension or termination after notice.

quote.text: suspend or terminate the Customer's access to the Services in accordance with Section 12 if the Customer does not comply with a request under this section.

finePrint.summary: All plans include chat support, with Start and Scale recommended for fuller onboarding help.

quote.text: Every plan includes chat support. For more comprehensive onboarding and setup assistance, we recommend Start or Scale.

finePrint.summary: Every plan includes chat support, with extra onboarding help focused on higher tiers.

quote.text: Every plan includes chat support. Start and Scale are recommended when you need more comprehensive onboarding and setup assistance.

finePrint.summary: Lifetime access is whatever the marketplace offer describes upon code redemption.

quote.text: Upon redemption of a valid license code issued by such a marketplace, Forento grants the Customer access to the Services as described in the corresponding offer.

finePrint.summary: Paid tiers are sold as subscriptions buyers can cancel anytime after a trial.

quote.text: Join now and keep the same price forever. Every paid tier includes a 30-day free trial, and you can cancel at any time.

finePrint.summary: The Start plan normally costs $39 per month billed annually with no sales commission.

quote.text: $39/month 0% sales commission Billed annually 30-day free trial Build your website and interact with your customers.

finePrint.summary: The Scale plan normally costs $119 per month billed annually for advanced tools.

quote.text: $119/month 0% sales commission Billed annually 30-day free trial Advanced tools for a growing knowledge business.

trials.claimQuote: Free SSL certificate when designing your custom website
trials.reasoning: No exhibits were admitted for this claim, so there is no evidence to confirm or contradict free SSL.

trials.claim: Startup plans can build lead magnets, blogs and funnels
trials.claimQuote: Build lead magnets, blogs, and funnels for your custom website
trials.reasoning: E1 reports the three-code purchase equals a Basic plan that does not include website or funnel creation, directly conflicting with building funnels for a custom website.

exhibits.quote: The three codes is only equivalent to Forento Basic 2 plan, which does not include website or funnel creation.
exhibits.argument: The quote reports that the Startup-equivalent purchase does not include funnel creation, contradicting the claim.

trials.claim: Startup plans can create own community to interact with followers and students
trials.claimQuote: Create your own community and interact with your followers & students
trials.reasoning: E4 states the community is included with Start and Scale, and E5 describes building a website and interacting with customers. E2 and E3 only note limits such as one community channel, not that no community is available.

exhibits.quote: That means that several key features are unavailable from the get-go: bundles, content dripping, Zapier integration, and more than one community channel.
exhibits.argument: The quote reports Startup plans are limited to one community channel, undermining the community claim.

exhibits.quote: Limited community functionality on plans listed on AppSumo - I host my membership site elsewhere
exhibits.argument: The quote reports limited community functionality on the AppSumo Startup plans.

exhibits.quote: Basic includes a custom domain and removes the Forento watermark. The website builder, blog, and community are included with Start and Scale.
exhibits.argument: The vendor states the community feature is included with Start and Scale plans.

exhibits.quote: Build your website and interact with your customers.
exhibits.argument: The vendor describes the Start plan as including website building and customer interaction.
